info.title: Rubico Lead Engine API
info.description: Consumed by the React dashboard SPA, served same-origin behind a proxy. Authenticated by an httpOnly session cookie (§8.3).

headline.description: One line: who they are and why now.

signal_id.description: Must be an id from the SIGNALS block.

suggested_opening_line.description: FR-AI7: must reference only cited evidence.

risks.description: Reasons this might not be a fit.

has_rubico_opportunity.description: False when the company is outside the ICP or needs nothing Rubico sells.

evidence_sufficient.description: False when the signals are too thin to justify a human looking at this.

likely_need.description: One sentence on what this company probably needs. Empty when there is no opportunity.

rubico_capabilities.description: Specific Rubico capabilities that apply, e.g. "Laravel", "AI-generated code hardening".

capability.description: The specific Rubico capability that addresses it (from the capability map).

signal_ids.description: Ids from the SIGNALS block supporting this step. Must be non-empty.

reasoning.description: Why, in two sentences at most.
